raw.rationale: CX-4945 (silmitasertib) is a potent, relatively selective CK2 inhibitor whose antiproliferative activity is largely context-dependent, with published PRISM/CTRP data showing only modest lineage enrichment rather than strong single-lineage selectivity at 2.5 µM. The highest probabilities are assigned to lineages with known CK2 dependence or sensitivity signals (e.g., hematologic/brain/colorectal), but all remain low given typical 0.2–2.5% base rates.
